content:
## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `cmp32` (32-bit registered unsigned comparator: y = (a < b)) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module cmp32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [0:0] y_o
);

wire lt_0 = (a_i[31:0] < b_i[31:0]);
wire eq_0 = (a_i[31:0] == b_i[31:0]);

wire cmp_0 = lt_0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 1'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= cmp_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 268.926 um^2, WNS 7.62112 ns, score 75.942274.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 177.156 um^2, WNS 7.69083 ns, estimated score 76.731144 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: I'll start by exploring a few structural variants with the cheap estimator.
Interesting — WNS is nearly identical across very different structures, suggesting a large fixed component. Let me probe the timing floor.
Baseline logic costs only ~0.19 ns over a zero-logic floor (7.88), so gains are bounded. Let me verify the best candidate and test one more depth structure.

content.text: V3 (mixed radix 2/3/2/3 tree) estimates best at 76.933. Verifying formally before the final submission.

Final result: **76.183** (baseline 75.942, +0.241).

**What worked:** The critical path is dominated by a fixed input-delay/clock component — a zero-logic reference showed a ceiling of ~7.88 ns slack versus the baseline's 7.69, so only ~0.19 ns of comparator logic was up for grabs, and area contributes only 0.001/µm². I therefore optimized purely for logic depth, building explicit parallel-prefix comparators (g = ~a&b, p = a~^b, combine G = G_hi | P_hi·G_lo).

**Search results (estimate_ppa, which tracked P&R to within ±0.05):** plain `a<b` 76.78 est; radix-2 binary tree 76.77; radix-4 tree 76.42; folding the enable mux into the final AOI 76.57 (worse — 5-input AOI221 is slow); leaf-level `<`/`==` chunks 76.57–76.60. The winner was a mixed-radix tree whose levels match the library's cell repertoire: 2-bit groups (AOI21) → 6-bit groups (AOI221, radix-3, using 4-wide p-products precomputed in parallel) → 12-bit groups (AOI21) → a radix-3 top combine, with all equality products scheduled so they are never on the critical path. That reached 7.711 ns est / 76.93, and post-route 265.2 µm², WNS 7.645 ns, score 76.183 — an improvement in both area and timing over the reference.

input.summary: Improved cmp32 from 75.942 to 76.183 post-route (area 268.9→265.2 um^2, WNS 7.621→7.645 ns). Diagnosis first: a zero-logic probe showed the slack ceiling is ~7.88 ns, so only ~0.19 ns of comparator logic delay was available and area is worth only 0.001/um^2 — hence the whole effort went into minimizing logic depth. I implemented explicit parallel-prefix comparators (g=~a&b, p=a~^b, G=G_hi|P_hi&G_lo) and swept radices with the cheap estimator, which tracked place-and-route to within 0.05: plain `<` 76.78 est, radix-2 tree 76.77, radix-4 tree 76.42, enable-mux folded into the final AOI221 76.57 (slower 5-input cell), 2-/4-bit leaf compares 76.57-76.60. The best structure was a mixed-radix tree matched to the Nangate45 cell set: 2-bit groups (AOI21) -> 6-bit groups (radix-3 AOI221 fed by 4-wide equality products computed in parallel) -> 12-bit groups (AOI21) -> radix-3 top combine, with every equality product scheduled off the critical path, plus a restructured flop (valid_o<=valid_i&rst_n, y_o<=en?LT:(y_o&rst_n)). It was formally proven equivalent and simulated clean, giving est 76.93 and final post-route 76.183. Three P&R submissions used (76.052, 76.109, 76.183); further structural variants all converged to the same ABC mapping, so additional gains were unlikely.
